    output_ptr,
    reduction_blocked_4_warps: gl.constexpr,
):

    load_columns = gl.arange(0, 32, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, parent=reduction_blocked_4_warps))

    valid_reduction_blocked_4_warps = (load_rows[:, None] < 8) & (load_columns[None, :] < 31)
    acc_x = gl.convert_layout(gl.load(input_ptr + load_offsets, mask=valid_reduction_blocked_4_warps, other=0.0), reduction_blocked_4_warps)
    acc_y = gl.zeros((8, 32), gl.float32, layout=reduction_blocked_4_warps)
    for _ in range(2):
        v0_left, v0_right = gl.broadcast(acc_x, acc_y)
        v0 = v0_left + v0_right
        v0 = gl.convert_layout(v0, reduction_blocked_4_warps)
        reduction_blocked_4_warps_rows = gl.arange(0, 8, layout=gl.SliceLayout(1, parent=reduction_blocked_4_warps))
        reduction_blocked_4_warps_columns = gl.arange(0, 32, layout=gl.SliceLayout(0, parent=reduction_blocked_4_warps))
